issue.title: Bug: Timeout waiting for SNMP facts after 300 seconds

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

We are seeing errors where snmp_facts are timing out:

```
Failed: SNMPv3 valid credentials verification failed: Timeout waiting for SNMP facts after 300 seconds
```

The origin of the issue is:
```
AttributeError: module 'pysnmp.hlapi.v3arch.asyncio.cmdgen' has no attribute 'usmHMACSHAAuthProtocol'
```

Root cause is recent removal of the backwards compatibility mapping for protocol namings in pysnmp (for versions earlier than 5) was moved to a different location.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run snmp tests.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

all tests shall pass.

resolution.title: update pysnmp APIs to support newer lib
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Fix SNMP test failure because of missing constants.

Summary:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/22323

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
snmp tests failure

#### How did you do it?
In pysnmp v4, authentication and privacy protocol constants (like usmHMACSHAAuthProtocol, usmHMACMD5AuthProtocol, etc.) were accessible through the cmdgen module.
In pysnmp v5+, these constants were moved to a different location and are now defined in pysnmp.hlapi.v3arch.auth module. They need to be imported separately and are not automatically available through cmdgen.
